test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. We reached there at about 10 a.m.

B. The first ride we took was the Fury Wheel. It was really big, all of us were yelling and crying!

C. Yesterday, my friends and I went on a short picnic to an amusement park.

D. Even though we had reached on time there was a serpentine queue for the tickets. I took the entrance ticket.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **CADB**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph talks about a short picnic to an amusement park with friends.
 
• **Sentence C **introduces the topic and sets the context.
 
• **Sentence A** provides information about the time of arrival.
 
• **Sentence D** talks about the queue for tickets and the narrator taking the entrance ticket.
 
• **Sentence B** describes the first ride they took and their reactions. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Correct Sequence:**__

**C. **Yesterday, my friends and I went on a short picnic to an amusement park.

**A. **We reached there at about 10 a.m.

**D.** Even though we had reached on time there was a serpentine queue for the tickets. I took the entrance ticket.

**B.** The first ride we took was the Fury Wheel. It was really big, all of us were yelling and crying!
